stages.name: Ground rules and conventions
stages.goal: Conventions every later document relies on.

stages.name: Kernel core model
stages.goal: Data model, trust, authority, invariants and threats.

stages.name: Kernel mechanisms
stages.goal: Bootstrap, cryptographic lifecycle, time, levels, extension model, security.

stages.name: Message, identity and policy foundations
stages.goal: Envelopes, identity, errors, policy, versioning.

stages.name: Session and work protocols
stages.goal: Boot, session launch, authorization, work orders, execution, evidence.

stages.name: Cross-cutting requirements
stages.goal: Requirements that apply across every component.

stages.name: Package framework
stages.goal: Runtime packages, capabilities, lifecycle and system packages.

stages.name: Authority completion
stages.goal: Bring amk-authority to a closed, consistent specification.

stages.name: Console completion
stages.goal: Bring amk-console to a closed, consistent specification.

stages.name: Controller and session-router completion
stages.goal: Bring amk-controller and the session-router to a closed specification.

stages.name: Runtime and prompt completion
stages.goal: Bring amk-runtime and amk-prompt to a closed specification.

stages.name: Implementation foundations
stages.goal: What an implementation must provide and enforce.

stages.name: Platform profiles
stages.goal: Basic, Standard and High platform capability tiers.

stages.name: Compliance model
stages.goal: Obligation scheme, projections, evidence linkage, certifiable output.

stages.name: Conformance artefacts
stages.goal: Taxonomy, declaration, harness interface, vectors, trust map.

stages.name: Traceability and certification
stages.goal: Traceability matrix and certification guidance.

stages.name: Reference material
stages.goal: Informative architecture, decisions, examples, compliance mappings.

stages.name: Governance and legal
stages.goal: Governance, contribution, security, licensing.

stages.name: Cross-spec integration
stages.goal: Make the whole framework consistent and indexed.

stages.name: Release
stages.goal: Top-level documents, versions and the release itself.
